svg.title: Would a ship canal pay? Gillmore's figures, 1880
svg.desc: Millions of tons a year at a toll of 28 cents a ton: about 1,758,000 tons to pay the canal's running costs; about 2,600,000 tons passed through the Florida Straits in the last fiscal year; about 10,714,300 tons to pay running costs and 5 per cent on a construction cost of about $50,000,000.
svg.text: Would a ship canal pay? Gillmore's figures, 1880
Millions of tons a year, at a toll of 28 cents a ton. The labels link to the passage.

a.text: Passed the Florida Straits in a year
Needed to pay costs and 5 % on $50,000,000

svg.text: Gillmore: “it is impossible to answer satisfactorily the question of the capacity of the enterprise to yield a moderate interest”.
He thought a national canal need not pay; later reports measured every plan by its benefits and costs.
